title: Closing and Funding Returned Funding Wires
content:
Under the Closing and Funding product, a funding wire can come back to Larkspur Home Lending. This policy says what a returned wire does to the closing and how its cause is classed.

**Rule.** A wire the settlement agent returns before disbursing (a settlement agent rejection), or that Larkspur recalls because a prior-to-funding item was open (funding conditions unmet), puts the closing back to signed; it is re-sent within the method's returned-wire re-send business days of the cause being fixed, and the new wire date becomes the disbursement date. A Larkspur-side return (a wrong amount, wrong account or Larkspur's own open condition) is Larkspur's delay for interest purposes; a return caused by the settlement agent's or the borrower's error is not. Wires returned because the borrower rescinded or the closing was cancelled end the funding.

| Cause of the return | Closing goes back to signed and the wire is re-sent? | Larkspur's delay for interest purposes? |
|---|---|---|
| wrong amount sent by Larkspur | Yes | Yes |
| wrong account | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur's own open prior-to-funding condition | Yes | Yes |
| settlement agent's own error | Yes | No |
| borrower's error | Yes | No |
| borrower rescinded | No, the funding ends | not applicable |
| closing cancelled | No, the funding ends | not applicable |

Hypothetical: a wire returned on a Tuesday because Larkspur recalled it for an open condition, with the condition cleared that same Tuesday, is re-sent within 1 business day under a method whose re-send figure is 1, and the new wire date becomes the disbursement date.
